summary: d8a.tech is an analytics service designed to integrate with standard Google Analytics configurations. It intercepts user activity data and routes it directly into a self-hosted database under your control. This allows you to retain raw event logs without relying entirely on third-party cloud storage.
goodFor: This is well suited for administrators who already use Google Analytics for event tracking but require a private, self-hosted archive of their raw data.
watchOut: The repository has a relatively low community adoption and slowing development activity, which could indicate limited support for breaking upstream changes. It also overlaps heavily with established self-hosted tracking alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires a persistent volume for internal data storage and an external reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
